import pandas as pd

# File paths
source0_path = 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/test_0.csv'
source1_path = 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/test_1.csv'
target_path = 'autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length1_8/target_multisource_cot.csv'

# Load source tables
source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path)  # columns: track_id, dummy
source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path)  # columns: index_track, track_id

# Join on 'track_id' to get all three columns
merged = pd.merge(source1, source0, on='track_id', how='inner')

# Select and reorder columns as per target schema
target = merged[['index_track', 'track_id', 'dummy']]

# Ensure correct dtypes
target = target.astype({'index_track': 'int64', 'track_id': 'int64', 'dummy': 'int64'})

# Save to CSV
target.to_csv(target_path, index=False)
